title: Iron Monsoon
synopsis: A disgraced coast-guard pilot has one stormy night to stop a heist on a floating port before the monsoon swallows it whole. Grounded after a rescue gone wrong, Sameer Khan is the only one who spots the crew slipping aboard — and the only one reckless enough to fly into the eye of the storm.

title: Midnight in Anarkali
synopsis: Two strangers keep meeting in Lahore's oldest bazaar at midnight — and each time, a different decade waits outside. As Zoya and Hamid trace the lanes from the 1950s to the present day, they realise the bazaar is trying to tell them something about a love story that ended too soon, and that their own meetings may not be an accident at all.

title: Orbit of Ash
synopsis: The last crew of a mining station must decide whether to return to an Earth that has stopped answering. With oxygen rationed and the station's AI keeping secrets of its own, commander Rhea Calloway has to choose between the mission she was sent on and the people who are still alive to bring home.

title: Shehr-e-Raaz
synopsis: A crime reporter follows a trail of anonymous letters through the Walled City and finds her own name in the last one.

title: Chai & Chaos
synopsis: Three generations, one tiny dhaba and a wedding catering order that was never supposed to be theirs.

title: Hollow Pines
synopsis: A winter retreat in the Murree hills turns sinister when the guests realise the forest is counting them.

title: Paper Kites
synopsis: On the eve of Basant, a shy boy's homemade kite comes alive and carries him across a city of rooftops.

title: Raag
synopsis: A gifted qawwal's daughter defies her family to compete in a national music contest — on her father's harmonium.

title: Velocity Zero
synopsis: When time freezes for everyone but her, a courier races to deliver the one package that can restart the world.

title: The Last Lantern
synopsis: A lamplighter's apprentice must carry the final flame across a kingdom where darkness has a voice.
